title: The 4 Best Travel Neck Pillows Under $20
h1: The 4 Best Travel Neck Pillows Under $20
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for travel neck pillows under $20, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at travel neck pillows under $20 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: MLVOC Inflatable Travel Pillow
products.blurb: Key specs: Inflatable U-shape with adjustable firmness, Micro-velvet cover, Includes eye mask, earplugs, and drawstring bag.
strengths: Full accessory kit included at that price, unusual for the category
Deflates flat, taking up almost no packed space when empty
Adjustable firmness by how much air you add
limitations: Needs to be inflated and deflated each trip
features: Includes eye mask, earplugs, and drawstring bag

products.name: Trtl Pillow Travel Neck Pillow
products.blurb: Key specs: Scarf-style wrap with internal support plinth, Weighs about 4.5 ounces, Machine washable.
strengths: Meaningfully better head support than the inflatable MLVOC in day-to-day use
Packs almost as flat despite not being inflatable
features: Scarf-style wrap with internal support plinth

products.name: J-Pillow Travel Pillow
products.blurb: Key specs: J-shaped foam design, Non-inflatable fill, Machine washable.
strengths: Highest owner rating of the pillows in this article
Foam holds its shape indefinitely, no inflating required
limitations: Bulkier to pack than the inflatable MLVOC

products.name: Cabeau Evolution S3 Travel Pillow
products.blurb: Key specs: Dense memory foam horseshoe with seat strap, Quick-dry cover, Typically priced around $40.
strengths: The most supportive pillow across this whole category
Strap system found on no other pillow in this comparison
features: Dense memory foam horseshoe with seat strap

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
